summary: Boost Run Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting that its subsidiary Boost Run LLC entered a Service Agreement with Cohere Inc. on September 30, 2026, to provide dedicated GPU cloud computing infrastructure and related services. Term per rack is approximately five years, with initial acceptance expected in Q2 2027; Cohere committed to pay approximately $525.6 million over the term, a portion prepaid. Termination rights exist if minimum infrastructure is not accepted by July 15, 2027. The Company guarantees prepayment refunds. This is a commercial supply contract, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
